ceiling_directive: Resolve the response-interior uniform-inference question by proving coverage under explicit margin and step-rate conditions together with a matching face-switching failure construction outside that regime.
improvement_directive: Strengthen the response-boundary singleton diagnostic into a response-interior theorem: establish uniform simultaneous validity under explicit rates and a matching rare-margin counterexample when those rates fail, including nonunique optimal faces.
critique: The exact selector interval is standard finite transportation geometry, while the SCM result only realizes that geometry inside the note's explicitly free, selector-specific abstraction class and does not preserve a common canonical Layer-3 map. The derivative and pointwise numerical-delta conclusions are finite-dimensional specializations of established LP sensitivity and numerical-delta machinery. The sole claimed new uniform result is a zero-coverage example for one deliberately boundary-degenerate singleton with collapsing Bernoulli means and variances; it establishes neither failure on the response-interior class nor the advertised rare-margin threshold or any comparative advantage over existing procedures. The effective-support identification criterion, endpoint flow-certificate theorem, response-interior uniform theory, width comparison, and substantive PDX analysis are all absent, leaving the delivered package below a field-level contribution despite the framing accurately disclosing those limitations.
